soundness_flags.label: ass:negligible-max-influence
soundness_flags.one_line: For baseline outcomes it follows from bounded fourth moments plus the variance margin, and for normalized midranks it follows from boundedness plus the variance margin.

soundness_flags.label: ass:correlation-margin
soundness_flags.one_line: Since \(\kappa_j\le1\) and \(\rho\ge\rho_0>0\), \(1-\kappa_j^2(1-\rho)\ge\rho_0\); use this deterministic bound rather than separately assume a covariance margin.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops finite-population CLTs for randomization-based causal analyses, including general experimental designs and vector outcomes; it does not state selected conditional or data-dependent-reference transfer.
The paper proves selective asymptotic transfer under independent sampling and randomized selection; it does not analyze without-replacement finite-population Fisher-reference laws.
The paper represents discretized adaptive policies and solves a sparse-program approximation that minimizes expected sample size subject to power and familywise-error constraints.
